# Downloaded fixture license notes

The six originals are official translations of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights downloaded directly from the United Nations Office of the High Commissioner for Human Rights. They are public UN/OHCHR documents used here only as small interoperability and OCR acceptance fixtures.

The repository retains each downloaded original and a locally derived single-page, image-only PDF/PNG. No login, DRM, paid content, personal file, executable content, macro, or remotely loaded asset is involved. The original and derived SHA-256 values are recorded in `SOURCE_MANIFEST.csv`.
